off_screen: Take a slow walk with a grown-up. Stop at one leaf, one shadow, and one puddle — look closely and say what you notice.
parent_note: World observation: looking closely at small details, watching change over time, shadow-and-sun connection, slow counting. Bobo models calm, careful looking.

story_beats.art_note: Morning path by a pond; Bobo the mint-green tortoise walks very slowly, head up, eyes wide and curious, a big leaf in front of him.
story_beats.text: Bobo the tortoise walks very, very slowly. 'Slow eyes see MORE,' he says. 'Come on my slow walk with me. We will stop… and LOOK.'

story_beats.art_note: Bobo's face close to a green leaf, one eye huge and curious; tiny bumps visible on the leaf surface.
story_beats.text: Bobo stops at a leaf. 'This leaf has tiny bumps! Smooth leaves feel different. When we look closely, every leaf tells a story.'

story_beats.art_note: Three panels: morning puddle big and round, afternoon puddle smaller, evening dry patch with Bobo's footprints.
story_beats.text: Bobo watches one puddle all day long. 'Morning — big! Afternoon — smaller… Evening — gone! The sun drank it up, sip by sip.'
'Now it is YOUR turn to look slowly,' says Bobo, blinking gently. 'Four little looking-jobs. Slow eyes, slow fingers… and take all the time you need.'
'You are a wonderful watcher!' Bobo smiles his slowest smile. 'Remember — when you slow down and look closely, the whole world has secrets to show you.'
